# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P4](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is noted for being quite fat and short for a girl claiming to be a fairy queen. She has a malicious smile and is seen as unpleasant in her looks when compared to others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## Personality

Josie is known as a cheat, sulky, and malicious. She possesses a very sharp, disagreeable tongue and frequently makes sarcastic or spiteful remarks about others. Lacking imagination and sympathy, she often takes pleasure in the embarrassment or misfortunes of her classmates. Despite her unpopularity and lack of tact, she maintains a vain, triumphant, and arrogant demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v2 c1 P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)_

## Traits

- Malicious  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>
- Dishonest and cheating  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- Sulky  <sub>[v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)</sub>
- Sharp-tongued and disagreeable
- Lacking imagination  <sub>[v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences with skill  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## History

Josie attends the Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her classmates. Known for her spiteful nature and cheating habits, she frequently clashes with others or causes friction, such as peeping at her book during a spelling class. At a party hosted by Diana Barry, she excels at walking a board fence and challenges Anne to walk the ridgepole of a roof, which leads to Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Josie later joins the Queen's Academy prep class and passes the entrance examination, subsequently attending Queen's with her peers. After graduating, she decides to return to Queen's for further education rather than teach.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_
